summary: Task Management made meaningful substrate progress on 2026-03-15: TDE runtime pathing hardened, post-acceptance progression traces added, assignment-acceptance thin-slice plan defined, and the Vega/PXS filesystem-tool boundary tightened. However, the two headline blockers remain open: the Vega/PXS boundary E2 condition is still FAIL (exec-based cross-domain access remains open despite fs-tool narrowing), and the assignment acceptance thin-slice has a plan but no implementation yet. Downstream pxs consumption is still blocked. TOP_PRIORITIES.md was reviewed against the full product stack, found substantively valid but with stale P3 status text; Priority 3 status note updated to reflect 2026-03-15 execution progress. Priority ordering unchanged.

materialChanges.change: TDE runtime pathing hardened: core TDE tools now default to canonical runtime paths (os/runtime/tde_state.sqlite); active/staging split no longer occurs by default.
materialChanges.significance: Reduces silent cross-path reliability risk that was flagged in the prior report blocker list.

materialChanges.change: Post-acceptance progression traces added: task_activated and task_progressed events now emitted, making accepted assignments visible beyond the initial acceptance event.
materialChanges.significance: Closes the observability gap identified in the ERR-2026-03-14 silent-limbo error report.

materialChanges.change: Assignment limbo detector (tools/tde_assignment_limbo_check.py) implemented. Silent-limbo condition is now a first-class detectable state.
materialChanges.significance: Prevents future silent-limbo failures from requiring manual forensic investigation.

materialChanges.change: Vega/PXS filesystem-tool boundary enforcement applied: px-internal-dev no longer has fs.workspaceOnly=false override.
materialChanges.significance: Partial boundary progress. Convenience cross-workspace fs reads removed. However E2 is still FAIL because exec-based cross-domain access remains open.

materialChanges.change: Assignment acceptance thin-slice plan published. First executable slice scoped: explicit acceptance states returned and persisted, five canonical acceptance outcomes defined.
materialChanges.significance: Plan is ready but implementation not yet executed. Trust gap from silent limbo remains open at the implementation layer.

materialChanges.change: PXS access surface baseline documented: explicit record of what px-internal-dev had before and after enforcement, and what gap classes to expect.
materialChanges.significance: Enables fast triage of capability-delivery gaps as they surface under enforced boundary.

topPriorities.title: Close the Vega/PXS boundary readiness gap and rerun it to PASS
topPriorities.current_state: Filesystem-tool surface narrowed. E2 (exec-based cross-domain read) still FAIL. Boundary is tighter but not fully enforced. Acceptance sheet has not yet been rerun to PASS.
topPriorities.next_concrete_step: Decide whether E2 acceptance requires exec/sandbox tightening or a narrowed acceptance claim; apply the chosen path and rerun the acceptance sheet with committed evidence.

topPriorities.title: Deliver a minimal executable pxs consumption contract with schemas and worked examples
topPriorities.current_state: Operating-contract artifact exists. Executable schema-backed layer, transport semantics, and worked examples not yet delivered. Priority 1 boundary work is a prerequisite.
topPriorities.next_concrete_step: Once P1 boundary is resolved, upgrade the pxs consumption interface from descriptive to minimal executable contract with request/response schemas, versioning, and 2-3 worked examples.

topPriorities.title: Stabilize and prove the canonical substrate that pxs will consume
topPriorities.current_state: Meaningful progress 2026-03-15: runtime pathing hardened, progression traces added, limbo detector implemented, assignment acceptance thin-slice plan ready. Implementation of acceptance slice not yet executed. DB-cutover GO/NO-GO decision path still open.
topPriorities.next_concrete_step: Implement the assignment acceptance thin-slice (tools/tde_assignment_accept.py returning explicit acceptance states with canonical persistence); then close the DB-cutover decision path with explicit GO/NO-GO evidence.

constraints.title: Vega/PXS E2 boundary enforcement is still FAIL despite fs-tool narrowing
constraints.detail: exec-based cross-domain access (sandbox.mode=off, exec.host=gateway, exec.security=full) remains open. Boundary is not fully enforced. E2 acceptance condition cannot be marked PASS until this is resolved or the acceptance statement is narrowed with explicit rationale.
constraints.nextStep: Decide E2 scope: sandbox/exec tightening vs narrowed claim. Apply and rerun acceptance sheet.

constraints.title: Assignment acceptance trust gap: thin-slice plan exists but implementation is outstanding
constraints.detail: producers can still mistake raw task-state insertion for operational acceptance. The thin-slice plan defines the correct fix path, but tools/tde_assignment_accept.py has not yet been updated to return explicit acceptance states.
constraints.nextStep: Execute the thin-slice implementation as the next coding step.

constraints.title: Downstream pxs consumption remains blocked by open boundary and incomplete executable contract
constraints.detail: Neither the boundary gate (P1) nor the executable interface (P2) is closed. pxs consumption remains soft and unsafe.
constraints.nextStep: Sequence: close P1 boundary, then advance P2 interface.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Vega/PXS boundary readiness failure blocks safe downstream consumption
risksOrOpportunities.detail: Partial improvement achieved but full enforcement still outstanding. Each day without full closure increases the risk that consumption work proceeds against an unsafe foundation.
risksOrOpportunities.mitigation: Treat E2 resolution as the single highest-priority gating action.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Readiness description outrunning readiness evidence
risksOrOpportunities.detail: No regression. Runtime pathing hardening and progression traces improve evidence quality. Claim-to-evidence gap is narrowing.
risksOrOpportunities.mitigation: Continue tying each new readiness claim to explicit artifacts and GO/NO-GO decision records.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Downstream consumption softer than product model suggests
risksOrOpportunities.detail: No regression; no new progress on the executable contract layer. Still depends on P1 boundary closure.
risksOrOpportunities.mitigation: Keep as the explicit P2 next step after P1.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Shadow operating state / silent limbo
risksOrOpportunities.detail: Materially improved: limbo is now detectable and progression traces are emitted. Trust gap remains at the acceptance implementation layer.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Execution substrate now has observable post-acceptance state
risksOrOpportunities.detail: With progression traces and limbo detection in place, TDE now has the minimal observability scaffold needed to move confidently toward broader operational use without silent-failure risk.
risksOrOpportunities.mitigation: Capitalize by completing the acceptance implementation slice and then running controlled end-to-end tests.
